title: VIPER
subtitle: Visual Instruction for Procedures & Emergency Repair

attendingLines: Good first bite. Hold that depth.
That is the last one. Clean work.

prompts.place: Look at the arm · air tap to place

steps.title: Scanning field
steps.attending: Welcome to VIPER. Hold still while I scan the field.

steps.title: Assess the wound
steps.attending: Training Patient 01. A 42 mm laceration on the right forearm. Vitals are stable.

steps.title: Know what is underneath
steps.attending: Check under the skin first. The radial artery runs beside this wound. Avoid the red zone.

steps.title: Plan the repair
steps.attending: Five simple interrupted sutures. Bites 5 mm from the edge, 8 mm apart, needle in at 90°.

steps.title: Place the sutures
steps.attending: Go ahead. Enter at the dot, follow the arc, and tie it down.

steps.title: Procedure complete
steps.attending: Wound closed. Five for five, even spacing. Well done, doctor.
